history.summary: A 4BR (1507 sqft) at ELTA Clementi Ave 1 (99yr, MCL Land/CSC, TOP ~2028) at $3.39M / $2250 PSF — close to ELTA's ~$2,537 PSF launch average, in a strong D05 location but at a high absolute quantum. history.rating_rationale: ELTA is a credible 501-unit project near Clementi MRT interchange and top schools, with strong launch demand — so a 4BR here has genuine underlying appeal. But $3.39M sits well above the liquid sweet spot, the $2250 PSF gives little discount to the launch average, and there's no resale history. Score 392 (lowest in batch) and below-frontier reflect a full-priced, high-quantum unit. Project quality holds it at Neutral; price and exit risk keep it from a Buy.
